Hi Karthik —

Attached is the formal subprocessor change notice for a new vendor, CypherData Ltd (UK), that will process telemetry logs for our integration. Procurement flagged that CypherData requires standard flow-down language in the MSA/Order Form and wants to ensure a DPA annex is agreed before they go live.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm you can accept CypherData as a subprocessor for the Order Form SOW (analytics/telemetry only)
- Provide the DPA annex that maps to our data categories and any SOC2 attestation or equivalent evidence
- Confirm anticipated time to sign the updated Order Form + DPA (we're targeting the week of Sep 22)

I've copied Acme Legal if they want to propose specific redlines; procurement would prefer minimal change but will need explicit flow-down obligations and audit/cooperation language.

Attachment: Acme_Subproc_Change_Notice.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Thanks —
Sofia Ramos

On Mon, Sep 15, 2025 at 10:03 AM karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> Sofia — thanks for the notice and the clear asks. We've started internal triage; next steps below.

Thanks everyone — I reviewed the change notice and the proposed scope. Below are the legal/security redlines and conditions for consent.

Redline summary (high level):
- Flow-down obligations: we can accept flow-down for the narrow telemetry/analytics scope provided that:
  * Subprocessor agreement includes the same confidentiality, security, and data handling obligations as Redwood's DPA (we propose an annex to the Order Form).
  * CypherData must accept audit cooperation (right to audit / evidence exchange) specific to telemetry processing; if Acme requires on-site audits we need to limit to notice + remote evidence first and evaluate on a case-by-case basis.
- Data minimization & retention: Add clear retention limits for telemetry (30 days raw, 12 months aggregated) unless Acme specifies otherwise in writing.
- PII carve-out: If any data could be PII, CypherData must be treated as a processor of personal data and the DPA obligations automatically extend. Please confirm scope now.
- Security evidence: Provide SOC2 Type II report OR ISO27001 certificate + recent penetration test report. If only SOC2 summary is provided, we will need a bridge letter confirming no control gaps.
- Sub-subcontracting: Any further subcontracting by CypherData requires prior written consent from Acme and Redwood; we will not blanket permit unlimited cascade without additional notice.

Timeline & next steps:
- Acme confirm scope (PII: yes/no) by EOD Thu Sep 18.
- Redwood legal will produce a tracked redline to the Order Form + DPA annex by Fri Sep 19.
- If Acme accepts redline, we will prepare DocuSign for signature; target signature week of Sep 22–26.

DocuSign / signature logistics: we can pre-seed the Order Form with the annex and email a combined package. DocuSign link (for reference): https://www.docusign.net/Signing/AcmeDocSign123

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf (clean), Redwood_OrderForm_v3.docx (clean).

If you prefer, we can take the redline call Thu 09/18 at 9:30 PT — please let us know.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
